status: Assessment only; no Illumina mapping policy selected or approved; D17 and D19 unchanged

definitions.option_a: package Entrez IDs + gene-history procedure (View A, cutoff 20260318); approved for GPL570 only (D6-F); provisional for Illumina
definitions.accession_route: unversioned accession match to org.Hs.eg.db 3.23.1 (accessions ∪ refseq); unique match only
definitions.M1: probes both routes assign; agreement vs post-gene-history Option A gene
definitions.M2: probes with one package Entrez ID and a unique accession-route gene; agreement vs the package's original ID
definitions.probe_denominator: all probes of the platform table (lumi: HumanHT12_V4_0_R2_15002873_B rows)
definitions.gene_counts: distinct current Entrez IDs; successor and historical source genes counted separately

statuses.decisive: settles the choice on its own (none qualify)
statuses.supportive: informative evidence that does not settle the choice
statuses.unresolved: comparative merit cannot be judged from retained evidence; required whenever advantage is 'not determinable'

reconstruction.full: full: recomputed from retained raw sources (package and org.Hs.eg.db tarballs)
reconstruction.partial: partial: accession-route side full; Option A side depends on the retained gene-history v1 records (raw NCBI gene_history.gz not retained, so those records cannot be rebuilt independently)

reconstructability.note: Option A replacement-dependent figures trace to the retained gene-history v1 records (the human records the audit used, kept verbatim in gene_history_reconciliation.tsv); the raw NCBI gene_history.gz (SHA-256 bcb85c8f…) is not retained and cannot be re-obtained byte-identically (ncbi_gene_history/SOURCE_RETENTION.md).
